name: navigate
description: Take the visitor to a page on the Adhouse site, or open the live worked example, when showing beats telling. Call with the destination.

destination.description: Where to take them: demo (the Malt Coast worked example), brief (start making ads), pricing, method, or home

name: start_brief
description: Start an ad brief for the visitor. Call this when they want you to actually make ads / start a brief and have given their brand name (and ideally website). It drops them onto the brief page with their details filled in.

website.description: The brand website domain, e.g. maltcoast.co.uk (optional)
